Help and support

Privacy policy

01 / CONNECT

Two dates, one reading

Explore a numerology-inspired pairing. The same two birth dates always produce the same score, whichever person goes first.

02 / FEEL THE MAGIC

A romantic little ritual

Soft pink and gold stars, a glowing violet orb, and gentle magical chimes set the mood. Mute the sounds whenever you like.

03 / SHARE

Send a little stardust

Share your compatibility score and reading title through the iOS share sheet, using an app or recipient you choose.

You write the real love story.

LOVE BALL is for entertainment only. Birth dates cannot predict relationship success, and the percentage is not a scientific probability. Real relationships grow through care, trust, and communication.

Readings are calculated on your device. No account is needed.
